Company Description

Wise AI is a Harvard-MIT-founded, VC-backed start-up focused on revolutionizing health monitoring through innovative technology. The company is developing a population-scale health monitoring solution that is accessible to anyone with a smartphone.

Our core offering is a health sensing platform that measures vital signs (heart rate, HRV, stress indicators, and more) using remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) — directly from a standard camera, without any wearables or additional hardware.

At Wise AI, we aim to empower individuals worldwide by making health tracking seamless, efficient, and universally available. Join us in creating cutting-edge solutions that have the potential to transform healthcare accessibility.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Founding Engineer in Fullstack Development, with a focus on ZoomApp integration. The Founding Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable software systems, building both front-end and back-end components, and integrating third-party platforms such as Zoom. Responsibilities include collaborating with cross-functional teams, ensuring optimal system performance, and contributing to a fast-paced start-up environment with innovation and problem-solving.

Qualifications

Proficiency in fullstack development and expertise in modern programming languages/frameworks (e.g., Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js)

Experience with ZoomApps (must-have)

Experience with API development

Strong skills in system design, database management, and performance optimization

Ability to build and maintain scalable, user-friendly, and responsive web applications

Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and DevOps practices

Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to adapt in a start-up environment

Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams

Prior experience in health-tech or a related field is a plus

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

Tech Stack (Flexible but Current Direction)

Frontend: React / TypeScript / Zoom Apps SDK

Backend: Python (FastAPI) / Node.js

Vision / ML: OpenCV, MediaPipe, PyTorch / TensorFlow

Signal Processing: SciPy, NumPy

Hosting: AWS / GCP

Version Control: GitHub

Design/Docs: Figma / Notion

You will influence and evolve this stack.

Why This Is Different

This is not just another engineering job.

You will be:

One of the first technical hires

A core part of product, research, and vision

Solving a truly hard, meaningful problem at the intersection of: Healthcare, AI, Computer Vision

Eligible for significant equity

Building a product that can help millions, including caregivers, clinicians, and the elderly

If you want your code to actually matter — this is it.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This is a great fit if you are:

A builder who wants to work on something deeply technical + highly human

A grad / PhD / engineer who has worked on CV or signals and wants real-world impact

A high-potential engineer tired of big-company bureaucracy

Someone excited by the idea: “What if Zoom could check your vitals?”

How to Apply

Email or message with:

A short intro

GitHub / portfolio / papers (if any)

1–2 projects (involving a ZoomApp) you're most proud of.

Contact:

evidence.statement: The supplied resume lists React, Next.js and TypeScript. The portfolio describes React components and hooks at Danzee Tech and React-based product interfaces at Tututor.ai, Illume, Viloi, Jurri and Yaksport. Self-reported source material reviewed; independent skill assessment has not been performed.

The resume and portfolio describe production Node.js, Express and MongoDB work at Tututor.ai and in Illume/Viloi, including shared APIs, data modeling and school-scoped data access. Self-reported project evidence reviewed.

The supplied sources describe AI lesson-topic chatbots, quiz generation and grading at Tututor.ai; AI-generated analytics at Illume; and provider fallbacks involving OpenAI, Claude and Gemini at Viloi. This supports application integration, not model-training or ML research expertise.

The current portfolio calls the Tututor.ai / EduNova role Lead Engineer, describes leading web and mobile developers, and states that the candidate now works directly with the founder on product and engineering. No formal product-management certification is claimed.
The supplied resume and portfolio describe JWT authentication, Stripe subscriptions and webhooks, SEPA billing, and Socket.io with Redis messaging in shipped products.

The current portfolio reports shipping React Native apps to both Apple and Google app stores and beginning a Kotlin Multiplatform core. It does not establish five years of mobile development or deep native-platform expertise.

The supplied resume and current portfolio agree on Danzee Tech January 2022-January 2024 and Tututor.ai November 2023-present. These overlapping periods support four-plus calendar years by October 2026; they must not be added together to inflate experience.

The resume identifies Tututor.ai as remote with the employer based in Murcia, Spain; the candidate is based in Pakistan. Danzee Tech is associated with Viby, Denmark. This supports international collaboration, not any particular English test score or work authorization.
The resume and portfolio describe code splitting, lazy loading and bundle optimization on Jurri, plus query and index hotspot work. No new quantitative performance claim has been inferred.
